title: Papyrus scopes content to the account a person selects
description:
Feature: A signed-in person's chosen account scopes a Papyrus site's content
  Scenario: One person with two accounts
    Given a person belongs to two Prospectus accounts on a Papyrus site
    When they pick one after Google sign-in
    Then the site's content requests carry that account as the tenant and never show the other account's content

Papyrus side (Papyrus repo, PPY-58f107): PR 299 merged to Papyrus develop 2026-10-18 and released; the selected Prospectus account, read from the sealed session cookie, becomes the request tenant, falling back to the site's own tenant on single-tenant sites. Still open on the Papyrus side: client-side news desk queries are not tenant-scoped yet, Markus import and section ids are still global, and the live lab host is not activated. No Prospectus API change was needed beyond the site registration (kanbus-275596). Production data is not changed until the pipeline deploys it.
